name: Email a morning sales report from web shop orders and accounting invoices with an AI agent
description: Every morning, collects yesterday's paid orders and invoices, applies the discount rules and emails the author a revenue table split by channel and payment type.
shortDescription: Get yesterday's revenue by channel and payment type in your inbox every morning.
keyFeatures: AI agent that reads web shop orders and accounting invoices through HTTP tools
Applies your discount rules and unit cost to calculate revenue and margin
Revenue table split by sales channel and payment type
Runs on a daily schedule and emails the report
prerequisites: Web shop with a REST API for orders (the HTTP tool uses the WooCommerce REST API path)
Accounting system with a REST API for invoices
Replace REPLACE_WITH_SHOP_DOMAIN, REPLACE_WITH_ACCOUNTING_API, REPLACE_WITH_UNIT_COST and REPLACE_WITH_AUTHOR_EMAIL
idealFor: Authors, self-publishers and small shop owners who sell through a web shop and invoices and want one revenue summary each morning.
steps: The sales analyst agent fetches yesterday's paid web shop orders and accounting invoices with its two HTTP tools.
The agent applies the discount rules and builds a revenue table by channel and payment type.
